title: Original Driving Ghost Tour of Charleston
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Not Recommended for travelers under 12 years old. The minimum age for guests is 12 years old.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience Charleston’s haunted history on a captivating one-hour ghost tour through the city’s most notorious locations. Travel in comfort aboard a climate-controlled passanger van, guided by an expert storyteller while a professional driver ensures a smooth, worry-free ride. With a small group of just nine guests, enjoy an intimate and engaging experience as you explore historic graveyards and ghostly landmarks, hearing chilling tales that bring Charleston's past to life.
